cand.title: European Para Championships 2027
cand.excerpt: Very strong mechanism and duration, but lowest current accessibility among airport-corridor candidates.
cand.ledgerVenue: Palexpo exhibition halls 4–6 and Congress Centre

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Best verified commercial entry: Alexis Schäfer, Head of Commercial, named on the official partnerships page; alexis@europeanparachampionships.com is the published Partnerships channel. Eric Kersten is named CEO in the June 2026 programme announcement and founder in the Geneva collaboration update. Gerrit Middag is advisor to EPC management. These are relevant routing/decision-influencing contacts, but none is publicly established as the accommodation contract signatory. Adrien Genier, CEO of Geneva Tourism & Convention Foundation, is a local tourism stakeholder, not a verified appointed housing buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed second edition: 2–15 August 2027, Geneva, Switzerland, within the requested horizon. These are event activity dates, independently stated by the organizer and venue, not publication dates. The organizer’s 2 June 2026 programme announcement projects more than 2,000 athletes across 12 sports.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: the overall event is far larger than a 237-room Founex hotel and is not a realistic whole-event hosting or plenary opportunity. A discrete officials, production, federation-support or appropriately assessed athlete subgroup could fit the supplied 20–120-room commercial band; this is a sales target, not published demand. Palexpo’s airport-corridor location makes the lodging hypothesis more plausible than a downtown-only programme, but a dedicated transfer plan is essential. YOTEL advertises accessible rooms, including an Accessible Premium Queen category; the accessible-room count and sports-specific suitability remain unknown. Its published airport shuttle is morning/evening, not pre-bookable and has no midday service: it must not be represented as an accessible team shuttle to Palexpo. Position as functional corridor accommodation, not a destination resort.
findings.venueCommitments: Palexpo exhibition halls 4–6 and Congress Centre, Route François-Peyrot 30, 1218 Le Grand-Saconnex, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. Territory classification: Geneva Airport corridor, not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, Lausanne or downtown Geneva. Additional public locations across Geneva are announced, but the full sport-by-sport venue allocation is not established here. This is a published venue commitment, not evidence of any hotel booking.
findings.historicalRotation: Inaugural edition: Rotterdam, Netherlands, 8–20 August 2023, centered on Rotterdam Ahoy with additional city/outdoor venues. Second edition: Geneva, 2–15 August 2027, Palexpo plus public locations. The organizer explicitly describes a four-year cycle, not annual recurrence. Its September 2026 update reports seven countries interested in 2031 or 2035; no subsequent host city, venue or exact dates were established. A return to Geneva is not confirmed.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027: unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau appointment, hotel list, contracted room blocks, open hotel RFP, peak-room figure or room-night total was found in the reviewed public material. No 2027 hotel can therefore be named as committed. The current contact page says, “please contact one of the following departments,” and lists General, Sports, Marketing & Communications and Partnerships, not a housing desk. Historical mechanism only: the 2023 official guide states, “All reservations during the registration procedure must be made through the Local Organizing Committee” and “All delegates inscribed for an official event must stay in one of the official hotels suggested by the organization.” The guide names Hilton Rotterdam; Vd Valk Hotel Blijdorp; Vd Valk Hotel Ridderkerk; NH Atlanta; NH Capelle Rotterdam; Nhow Rotterdam; Novotel Rotterdam Brainpark; WTC Postillion; Inntel Hotels Rotterdam Centre. These are historical hotels, not Geneva incumbents. The 2023 sport-specific para-cycling guide described accommodation as an optional package addition, so do not apply a single historical rule indiscriminately across sports or to 2027.
findings.organizationStructure: European Para Championships BV owns the concept and related broadcast, sponsorship and marketing rights; this is a corporate rights-holder-led sports event, not an association congress. The September 2026 update describes a centralized core team with decentralized national/local organizing structures. Palexpo is the competition/congress venue, not the event owner or a proven hotel buyer. Canton of Geneva, Geneva Tourism and Fondation de Handisport Genève appear as local stakeholders. No separately incorporated 2027 LOC, appointed PCO/DMC or housing agency was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No sourced 2027 overflow, hotel shortage, incumbent hotel commitment or unallocated room inventory was established. Do not infer accessibility from silence. Historical EPC accommodation was centrally coordinated and accessibility-screened, which suggests supplier qualification may matter more than proximity alone; applying that to 2027 remains an inference. Founex adds a transfer leg versus hotels immediately around Palexpo, and accessible inventory, transport, dining timings and equipment circulation must be tested before offering an athlete block.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Alexis Schäfer through the published Partnerships address, copy info@europeanparachampionships.com, and ask Eric Kersten’s team to identify the 2027 accommodation/operations procurement lead. Ask whether a central housing agent or LOC controls blocks, which hotels are contracted, what inventory remains and the supplier-selection deadline. Submit a conditional 20–120-room subgroup capability proposal only after checking the hotel’s accessible-room count/specifications, accessible coach access and lifts, catering, equipment storage and paid dedicated venue transfers. Do not promise availability, rates, accessible inventory or free event shuttles. Seek referral to the appointed housing lead before pursuing national teams directly.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The currently targeted edition is still upcoming in August 2027, not historical. Venue accessibility is established geographically; commercial procurement accessibility is unconfirmed. It is not evidenced as open, closed or committed elsewhere. The prior seed’s relative “lowest current accessibility” ranking cannot be verified from public evidence. Retain as a conditional supplier-qualification lead rather than a live hotel RFP.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: For 2027, seek consideration only for a defined accommodation subgroup if procurement remains flexible. For 2031/2035, develop a relationship with the rights holder and commercial team, but do not forecast local YOTEL Geneva Lake room revenue: the event rotates and no Geneva return is announced. The four-year recurrence supports relationship development, not an annual local room-night pipeline.
